name: 老年抑郁量表
instructions: 以下问题涉及您最近的感受。请根据您的实际情况回答“是”或“否”。
instructionsEn: The following questions concern how you have been feeling recently. Please answer “Yes” or “No” according to your actual situation.
license: Yesavage 等编制，可免费用于非商业用途，使用时请注明出处。

items.text: 您对自己基本满意吗？
items.textEn: Are you basically satisfied with your life?

items.text: 您是否放弃了很多活动和兴趣？
items.textEn: Have you dropped many of your activities and interests?

items.text: 您是否觉得生活空虚？
items.textEn: Do you feel that your life is empty?

items.text: 您是否经常感到无聊？
items.textEn: Do you often get bored?

items.text: 您是否对未来充满希望？
items.textEn: Are you hopeful about the future?

items.text: 您是否被一些难以摆脱的想法困扰？
items.textEn: Are you bothered by thoughts that you can't get out of your head?

items.text: 您是否大部分时间都心情愉快？
items.textEn: Are you in good spirits most of the time?

items.text: 您是否担心有不好的事情会发生？
items.textEn: Are you afraid that something bad is going to happen to you?

items.text: 您是否大部分时间都感到快乐？
items.textEn: Do you feel happy most of the time?

items.text: 您是否经常感到无助？
items.textEn: Do you often feel helpless?

items.text: 您是否经常坐立不安？
items.textEn: Do you often get restless?

items.text: 您是否宁愿待在家里，也不愿出去尝试新事物？
items.textEn: Do you prefer to stay at home rather than going out and doing new things?

items.text: 您是否经常为未来担忧？
items.textEn: Do you frequently worry about the future?

items.text: 您是否觉得自己的记忆力比别人差？
items.textEn: Do you feel that you have more problems with memory than most?

items.text: 您是否觉得活着是件美好的事？
items.textEn: Do you think it is wonderful to be alive?

items.text: 您是否经常感到心情沮丧？
items.textEn: Do you often feel downhearted and blue?

items.text: 您是否觉得自己现在毫无价值？
items.textEn: Do you feel pretty worthless the way you are now?

items.text: 您是否经常为过去的事担忧？
items.textEn: Do you often worry about the past?

items.text: 您是否觉得生活令人兴奋？
items.textEn: Do you feel that life is exciting?

items.text: 您是否觉得开始新项目很困难？
items.textEn: Is it hard for you to take on new projects?

items.text: 您是否觉得自己精力充沛？
items.textEn: Do you feel that you have plenty of energy?

items.text: 您是否觉得自己的处境毫无希望？
items.textEn: Do you feel that your situation is hopeless?

items.text: 您是否觉得大多数人都过得比您好？
items.textEn: Do you feel that most people are better off than you are?

items.text: 您是否常为小事心烦？
items.textEn: Do you often get upset over little things?

items.text: 您是否经常想哭？
items.textEn: Do you often feel like crying?

items.text: 您是否难以集中注意力？
items.textEn: Do you have trouble concentrating?

items.text: 您是否喜欢早上起床？
items.textEn: Do you enjoy getting up in the morning?

items.text: 您是否宁愿回避社交聚会？
items.textEn: Do you prefer to avoid social gatherings?

items.text: 您是否很容易作出决定？
items.textEn: Do you find it easy to make decisions?

items.text: 您的思维是否和以前一样清晰？
items.textEn: Is your mind as clear as it used to be?

totalBands.description: 总分低于11，未提示明显抑郁症状。
总分11-21，存在轻度抑郁症状，建议关注。
总分21及以上，存在重度抑郁症状，建议尽快寻求专业帮助。
